Privacy

Privacy notice

This page explains what information is collected through the HyrumHaircuts website and how it's used. It applies to the appointment-request form and is not a legal document tailored to every jurisdiction.

What is collected

When you request an appointment we collect your name, phone number, email address, requested date and time window, client type, any optional notes you add, and the fact that you agreed to be contacted. We also record the IP address a request was sent from, which is used only to prevent spam and abuse.

Why it's collected

This information is used only to schedule, confirm, and manage your appointment, and to contact you about it by text or email. It is not sold, and it is not used for marketing you haven't asked for.

Live calendar scheduling

If you choose to book through the embedded calendar instead of the request form, that scheduling happens directly with our calendar provider (Calendly), under its own privacy policy, not through this website's database.

How long it's kept

Appointment records are kept as a booking history rather than deleted automatically, so past appointments remain visible to the business. You can ask for your information to be deleted at any time using the contact method below, and it will be removed unless there's a legitimate reason (such as an unresolved dispute) to keep it.

Analytics

No analytics or tracking scripts are loaded by default. If an analytics tool is ever enabled, this page will be updated to name it.
